what: CI step neutered so the job stays green — the look-alike

input.content:
name: verify
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run audit
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: coverage
          path: coverage/
